scores.evidence: metrics.json has no hard failures (overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors). The s3-diagram flowchart TD has readable Japanese labels at 390 px (mobile-jp-10/11). But at 390 px the long lines of practice-setup and practice-answer are cut off at the right edge (mobile-jp-19, mobile-jp-25), and s1-table breaks words in odd places (mobile-jp-04/05).

textOnlyScreens is empty on both devices and the rhythm is good: headings, definitions, tables, code and checks alternate. The desktop median is 42 chars per line (target 30–40, max 50). In practice-setup the gutter shows 1–23, but practice-hint3 refers to CLAUDE.md lines 1–18, so the learner has to work out the offset.

This is a Japanese-only lesson. All labels, the diagram and the controls are in Japanese, with no stray English UI. Contrast is good, and no controls are hidden under the 56/60 px bars. Some table cells break mid-word on mobile, for example 「プロジェク/ト」 and 「変更をテストす/る」.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px, lines 6, 12, 13 and 14 of the sample CLAUDE.md are cut off at the right edge (for example 「テストは npm run test:unit で実行（npm te」 and 「ファイルを編集したら、毎回必ず npm run forma」). The learner cannot read the full lines they have to sort.
mustFix.fix: Keep every heredoc line under about 26 full-width characters. Split the long lines into two CLAUDE.md lines, or shorten them, for example 「テストは npm run test:unit で」 plus a separate line 「npm test はE2Eまで走って遅い」. Then update the line counts and numbers in practice-steps, practice-hint3 and the sed range in practice-answer.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px, lines 2 and 5–9 (the highlighted CLAUDE.md lines) and line 17 are cut off on the right, for example 「sed -n '12,18p' CLAUDE.md > docs/add-sc」 and 「<!-- 編集のたびの整形は、第8回でフックにする」.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the lines in the heredocs, for example 「- 単体テスト: `npm run test:unit`」 and 「- 画面追加: `docs/add-screen.md`」. Put the HTML comment on its own short line, and break the sed command with `\`. Alternatively, move the resulting CLAUDE.md into its own code block (filename CLAUDE.md, lang markdown) with short lines.

mustFix.issue: The code gutter numbers the sample's lines 1–23, with the CLAUDE.md content starting at line 5. practice-hint3 and practice-steps refer to CLAUDE.md lines (「5・6行目は拒否ルール」), but on screen 5 is 「# メモ帳アプリ」 and the .env line is 9. Learners will match the wrong lines.
mustFix.fix: Show the sample CLAUDE.md as its own code block (filename `CLAUDE.md`, lang markdown) so that the gutter numbers 1–18 match the hint. Keep a separate short bash block that tells the learner to create it, or say in practice-hint3 that the line numbers are CLAUDE.md lines, not terminal lines.

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the label column is about 5 characters wide, so labels break inside words: 「プロジェク/ト：チーム」, 「ユーザー：自/分」, 「ローカル：自/分（このプロ/ジェクトだけ）」, 「組織の管理ポ/リシー」.
mustFix.fix: Replace the table with a `definitions` block (term = 「プロジェクト（チームで共有）」 and so on; md = the file path). Definitions render full width on mobile, as s1-defs does. Or shorten the labels to single words (組織 / ユーザー / プロジェクト / ローカル) and move the scope into the file column.

niceToHave: s5-steps and practice-steps: every step title starts with a circled number (①…⑥) next to the reader's own step number circle, so the number shows twice (mobile-jp-16, desktop-jp-11). Drop the ①–⑥ prefixes from the titles.
s2-table: on mobile, the left column breaks verbs as 「変更をテストす/る」 and 「ファイルを整理す/る」 (mobile-jp-06/07). Shorter labels such as 「テストする」 and 「整理する」 would fit on one line.
Desktop JP median line length is 42 chars (target 30–40, max 50). This comes from the reader's measure (680 px at 18.7 px), not the lesson.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px (known).
reader: the end banner says 「このコースの最後のレッスンまで読み終えました。」 because drafts are not in course.json (known).
reader: horizontally scrolling code blocks have no scroll cue at 390 px (known), which makes the cut-off lines above harder to notice.
summary: No hard failures in metrics.json and no personal data on any screen. The lesson mixes tables, definitions, a readable flowchart TD diagram and frequent checks, so no screen is text-only. The most important fix: at 390 px the practice-setup and practice-answer code blocks cut off their long Japanese lines, and the sample's gutter numbers do not match the CLAUDE.md line numbers the hint uses. s1-table also breaks words in odd places on mobile.
